DUNGEON HOLD

A GNOME WARDEN · A CRYSTAL · THE HORDE

W A S D run   Shift sprint   mouse look   click swing   Space jump

number keys pick a defense   look where it goes, click to set it down   turn it with the mouse, R or wheel   click to build   E repair / upgrade   X sell   G start wave

Tab character sheet (gear + your numbers)   I tavern pages from anywhere   H swap hero model   drag a .glb file onto the page to play as your own character   M sound   N music

The horde drops loot. Walk over it to bag it. Between waves, go through the south door into the tavern: your locker holds your bag, the barkeep buys and sells, the trainer teaches skills, and the anvil forges gold into the gear you wear — every item takes 50 to 200 upgrade points by rarity, each point into a stat you choose (E at each, or I anywhere, Tab for the forge).

◆ mana builds, upgrades and repairs defenses during a run (the horde drops it)  ·  ● gold is spent at the tavern and stays with you  ·  🌱 roots cap how many defenses can stand at once
